title: Hello from the mock CMS
excerpt: This post lives in cms-poc-content/posts.json and stands in for a Sanity dataset.
author: CMS Spike
body: This page is rendered from the CMS proof-of-concept content source, not from the code-side blog library.
Edit this file, reload the page, and notice that nothing changes: the data is served from the tagged Next cache, exactly as a published Sanity document would be.

Then POST to /api/revalidate with the shared secret. The tag is invalidated, the next request re-reads the source, and the edit appears. That is the entire publish-to-revalidate loop this spike set out to prove.

title: A second post to make the list real
excerpt: Two posts make the index page an honest list instead of a special case.
author: CMS Spike
body: Nothing interesting here. This post exists so the list route renders more than one entry and per-slug cache tags can be exercised independently.
